'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*A 28-year-old [[White supremacy|white supremacist]] hijacks a truck in [[Winthrop, Massachusetts|Winthrop]], [[Massachusetts]], before crashing into an unoccupied home, causing extensive damage. He then fails to hijack another vehicle before opening fire on black bystanders, killing a woman and a man. Police exchange gunfire with the attacker, killing him at the scene. White supremacist rhetoric is found in the gunman's handwriting. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57647703 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Surfside condominium building collapse]]
**[[Mayor of Miami-Dade County|Miami-Dade Mayor]] [[Daniella Levine Cava]] orders an audit of older buildings in [[Miami-Dade County, Florida|the county]] following the [[structural integrity and failure|collapse]] of the [[condominium]] in [[Surfside, Florida|Surfside]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/graisondangor/2021/06/26/miami-dade-county-orders-audit-of-old-buildings-as-fire-slows-search-for-victims-in-collapsed-condo-tower/ (''Forbes'')]

**Five people are killed in a [[hot air balloon]] [[List of ballooning accidents|crash]] in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]], United States. [https://www.abqjournal.com/2403841/5-killed-in-hot-air-balloon-crash-on-west-side.html (''Albuquerque Journal'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ottawa]]
******[[Ottawa]] reports six new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, which is the region's lowest daily total since August 23, 2020. [https://ottawa.ctvnews.ca/mobile/ottawa-sees-lowest-daily-covid-19-case-count-in-10-months-1.5486798 (CTV News Ottawa)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]] 
*****[[Michigan]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Lineage B.1.617]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]] in a fully vaccinated person from [[Ottawa County, Michigan|Ottawa County]]. [https://nbc25news.com/news/state/ottawa-county-officials-find-first-west-michigan-case-of-covid-19-delta-variant (WEYI-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 21,095 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, 9,271 of which are from [[Jakarta]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.09 million. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5621184/dki-rekor-9271-kasus-ini-sebaran-21095-kasus-baru-covid-19-ri-26-juni (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]] 
****[[Taiwan]] reports its first six locally transmitted cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]] involving people living or having come into contact with an unlicensed [[taxicab driver]] from [[Pingtung County]]. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202106260010 (Focus Taiwan)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]] 
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 738 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 15,152. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/06/26/vietnam-reports-record-high-daily-covid-19-cases-total-now-is-above-15-000 (''The Star'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]] 
****[[Iceland]] becomes the first country in [[Europe]] to lift all remaining COVID-19-related restrictions due to a [[COVID-19 vaccination|vaccination]] campaign that saw 88% of the population receive at least one vaccine dose. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-06-iceland-coronavirus-restrictions.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] resigns after being caught on [[Closed-circuit television|CCTV]] breaking COVID-19 guidance that he had helped to create. [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] appoints former [[Chancellor of the Exchequer|Chancellor]] [[Sajid Javid]] as his replacement. [https://www.gbnews.uk/news/health-secretary-matt-hancock-resigns-after-breaching-covid-regulations/108411 (GB News)] [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/breaking-sajid-javid-named-health-24405498 (''The Mirror'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The [[New South Wales Government]] imposes a two-week "hard" [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in [[Greater Sydney]], the [[Blue Mountains (New South Wales)|Blue Mountains]], the [[Central Coast (New South Wales)|Central Coast]] and [[Wollongong]] until midnight on July 9. Residents are not allowed to leave their homes except for four essential reasons due to an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases in the region. In addition, weddings will be cancelled from June 28 until the end of the lockdown. [https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/what-are-the-covid-19-restrictions-for-the-greater-sydney-lockdown-20210626-p584ig.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***As [[South Africa]] faces its third wave of COVID-19, scientists say that the [[Delta variant]] of the virus appears to be dominating most of the infections in the worst-hit country in Africa. South Africa reported over 18,000 new cases on Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/delta-variant-starting-dominate-safrica-scientists-say-2021-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Peruvian general election]]
**[[Peru]] prepares for major protests in response to the June 6 election which saw socialist candidate [[Pedro Castillo]] of [[Free Peru]] winning the presidency by a narrow margin of 44,000 votes. Presidential candidate [[Fujimori Keiko]], who lost to Castillo in the second round, has called for several thousand votes to be blocked, largely from the rural areas, where she alleges that fraud occurred. Castillo's supporters have vowed to call for a general strike if his victory is not confirmed soon. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-braces-protests-election-body-slams-interruptive-arts-2021-06-26/ (Reuters)]
